# Yearn Internal Docs - Content Map

**Location**: `~/git/internal-docs`
**Knowledge base**: `docs/*.md` (Docusaurus, autogenerated sidebar, flat directory)
**Not knowledge base**: `src/`, `static/`, `middleware.ts`, `secure-server.mjs`, `docs-spec.md`
(these are the site's own code and hosting spec)

Regenerate the file list when the tree changes:

```bash
find ~/git/internal-docs/docs -name '*.md' -o -name '*.mdx' | sort
```

## Topic map

This table routes a question to a starting file. It is a routing aid, not a summary of the
docs: read the file and answer from its text. Some pages are stubs; check the page itself
rather than trusting this table to say what is filled in.

| Ask about | Read first |
|-----------|-----------|
| Who does what, team list, YIP-61 / YIP-88 teams | `docs/team-structure.md` |
| Shared tooling and who grants access | `docs/tools-and-access.md` |
| Internal dashboards and utilities | `docs/internal-yearn-websites.md` |
| Which Yearn repos are private and why | `docs/private-repos.md` |
| Deploying the docs site or related services | `docs/deployment.md` |
| Personal and operational security rules | `docs/opsec-checklist.md` |
| What to do during an exploit | `docs/hack-gameplan.md` |
| Multisig procedures | `docs/multisig-operations.md` |
| Secure development process | `docs/secure-development-lifecycle.md` |
| Known risks register | `docs/known-risks.md` |
| Keepers, keeper service, Debt Optimizer Applicator | `docs/tks-doa.md` |
| Dutch auctions for strategy reward tokens | `docs/auctions.md` |
| Vaults and strategies Yearn curates | `docs/curation.md` |
| How V3 fees are computed and charged | `docs/yearn-v3-fees.md` |
| How V3 vaults generate yield (explainer) | `docs/yield-explainer.md` |
| Integrators and sites pointing at Yearn | `docs/active-partnerships.md` |
| Acronyms and unfamiliar abbreviations | `docs/glossary.md` |
| Past incidents and writeups | `docs/yearn-history.md` |
| Verifying yearn.fi DNS and domain ownership | `docs/yearn-fi-domain-verification-checklist.md` |
| Release naming trivia | `docs/easter-eggs.md` |
| Purpose of the docs site itself | `docs/intro.md` |

Check `docs/glossary.md` first for any abbreviation you do not recognize.

## Search commands

```bash
# Find every page mentioning a term
grep -rniE 'keeper|doa' ~/git/internal-docs/docs

# List page titles from front matter
grep -H '^title:' ~/git/internal-docs/docs/*.md

# Find stubs still marked TODO
grep -lE '^TODO' ~/git/internal-docs/docs/*.md

# Show the last change to a page
git -C ~/git/internal-docs log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -- docs/tks-doa.md
```
